title: Hybrid Machine Learning for Imbalanced Landing-Phase Safety Event Prediction from Flight Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.08386v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Landing-phase safety-event prediction requires the detection of rare abnormal approaches within strongly imbalanced multivariate flight data. Capturing coupled temporal behavior while distinguishing event-specific signatures across airport operating contexts remains a central modeling challenge. This study proposes an interpretable hybrid feature-fusion framework for multiclass landing-phase safety-event prediction. A long short-term memory (LSTM) autoencoder trained on nominal flight windows characterizes deviations from routine approach behavior. Its continuous reconstruction-error descriptor is fused with parameter-specific statistical flight-history features and supplied to a class-weighted XGBoost classifier to distinguish Normal, Speed High, Path High, and Flaps Late windows. translated_title: 基于混合机器学习的飞行数据不平衡着陆阶段安全事件预测
translated_abstract: 着陆阶段安全事件预测需要在高度不平衡的多变量飞行数据中检测罕见的异常进近。在捕捉耦合时间行为的同时区分不同机场运行环境下的事件特定特征，仍然是一个核心建模挑战。本研究提出了一种可解释的混合特征融合框架，用于多类别着陆阶段安全事件预测。在正常飞行窗口上训练的长短期记忆（LSTM）自编码器用于表征偏离常规进近行为的程度，其连续的重构误差描述符与参数特定的统计飞行历史特征相融合，并输入类别加权的XGBoost分类器，以区分正常、速度偏高、航径偏高和襟翼放下过晚等窗口。该框架使用来自三个到达机场的53,750个NASA DASHlink进近窗口进行评估。混合学习与机场特定学习策略正在进…（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究提出一种可解释的混合特征融合框架，将LSTM自编码器的重构误差描述符与统计飞行历史特征融合后输入类别加权XGBoost分类器，以在高度不平衡的多变量飞行数据中实现多类别着陆阶段安全事件预测。
en_tdlr: This study proposes an interpretable hybrid feature-fusion framework that fuses LSTM autoencoder reconstruction-error descriptors with statistical flight-history features in a class-weighted XGBoost classifier to achieve multiclass landing-phase safety-event prediction from highly imbalanced multivariate flight data.
